title: North Boys: The Story of Jimmy and Charlie
original_title: North Boys: The Story of Jimmy and Charlie
overview: Charlie Pete of Lower Post, British Columbia, led a sometimes tortured and troubled life. So did his friend Jimmy Dennis. As children, both were taken from their homes on the same day in 1944. They never saw their families again. Both men have spent a lifetime trying to overcome the impact of that awful day and the eight years that followed.
